# Battery Guardian

Go beyond Android's basic battery monitor. Track true wear, health, aging metrics, and battery lifespan forecasts.

## Core Features
- Real-Time Tracking & Alerts: Monitors temperature, voltage, current, and charge levels.
- Damage Drivers & Aging: Details true effective cycles and actions causing excess wear.
- Diagnostic Tools: Identifies faulty chargers and pinpoint background app power drain.
- Privacy First: No forced ads, no telemetry data collected, no bloatware.
